annotations.title: Ask a panel of real humans

description: Ask registered real humans to rate, compare, judge, estimate, answer – or spot flaws in an image. Material can be text, an image URL or an audio URL. Returns request_id and status_token; the aggregated result (distribution, agreement, reasons) arrives via get_request_status or webhook, usually within a day. Free during the pilot. Formerly request_human_pulse. Done by the community: several anonymous humans answer through the Human Registry app – fast, remote, directional. Every task is reviewed by a human before it goes out. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot; acting for a business: price on request. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

audio_url.description: Optional https URL of an audio file (MP3, M4A, OGG, WAV, max ~1.8 MB).

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

deadline.description: Optional ISO date/time by which you need the result.

format.description: rate = 1–5, compare = pick one of the options, judge = yes/no/it depends, estimate = a number, answer = free text, spot = tap flaws in the image.

image_url.description: Optional https URL of an image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, max ~1.2 MB). Required for spot.

material.description: Optional text to read (no personal data).

options.description: For compare: the versions to choose from.

question.description: The question humans will see, e.g. 'How does this reminder feel to receive?' or 'Tap everything that looks wrong.'

scale_high.description: For rate: what 5 means, e.g. 'warm and human'.

unit.description: For estimate: unit, e.g. seconds, minutes, EUR.
